period_note: Solo (bank-only) Balance Sheet and Profit and Loss Account, read from National Bank's own Q3-2021 unaudited financial statements (OCR'd from a scanned PDF, cleanly legible). Comparative Balance Sheet column (31 Dec 2020) matches this dataset's existing FY2020 figures exactly for total_assets (529,052,549,451), total_deposits (430,747,950,818) and gross_loans (408,510,601,258); TOTAL SHAREHOLDERS' EQUITY comparative (52,058,701,994) carries the same ~34.86m (0.07%) immaterial divergence from the existing FY2020 equity noted in 2021_Q2.json, consistently reproduced by this filing too. All current-period Balance Sheet figures are cleanly printed. The P&L's 'Interest income' row itself was dropped from the OCR text (only 'Less: Interest paid...' and 'Net interest income' survive), so interest_income_cumulative is derived as net_interest_income_cumulative + interest_expense_cumulative. Every other P&L identity holds exactly from directly printed figures: Total Operating Income (7,513,137,385) = Net Interest Income (1,264,057,386) + Investment Income (4,783,389,665) + Commission (1,094,555,905) + Other Income (371,134,429); Profit Before Provision (2,193,686,489) = Total Operating Income - Total Operating Expenses (5,319,450,896); Profit Before Tax (1,343,686,489) = Profit Before Provision - Total Provision (850,000,000); PAT (1,093,686,489) = Profit Before Tax - Tax (250,000,000). This filing's own Jan-Sep-2020 comparative column independently reproduces every one of 2020_Q3.json's reconciled P&L figures (net interest income, investment income, commission, other income, operating expenses, profit before provision, provision, profit before tax, PAT) exactly, which is the primary cross-validation source used to reconstruct that heavily-garbled 2020_Q3 filing. EPS is the filing's own printed cumulative figure.
